description: This file defines a Kotlin class `BackupManager` responsible for managing backup and restore operations for an Android app's data. It includes methods for creating backups, restoring from backups, listing available backup files, and deleting backups. It interacts with the file system, preferences, and content resolver, and incorporates JSON processing.

classes.description: Manages backup and restore operations for app data.
